title: Draining Cleanse - Pictos Effect & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Draining Cleanse in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - what this Pictos does and exactly where to find it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Draining Cleanse is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Cleansing also drains health from the target.

sections.title: Effect
sections.content: Cleansing also drains health from the target.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
